tasks.label: Tizen: Build & Install on TV
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; PROJECT="${workspaceFolder}"; [ -f "$PROJECT/.env" ] || { echo 'ERROR: .env not found'; exit 1; }; set -a; source "$PROJECT/.env"; set +a; [ -n "$TIZEN" ] && [ -n "$TZCLI" ] && [ -n "$SDB" ] && [ -n "$TV" ] && [ -n "$PROFILE" ] && [ -n "$BUILD_DIR" ] || { echo 'ERROR: .env must set TIZEN, TZCLI, SDB, TV, PROFILE, BUILD_DIR'; exit 1; }; BUILD="$PROJECT/$BUILD_DIR"; echo '=== Connect ==='; "$SDB" connect "$TV" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; case "$("$SDB" devices)" in *"$TV"*) ;; *) echo "ERROR: TV $TV is not connected"; exit 1;; esac; echo '=== Clean ==='; rm -rf "$BUILD"; echo '=== Build ==='; "$TZCLI" build -w "$PROJECT" -s "$PROFILE"; echo '=== Package & sign ==='; "$TZCLI" pack -w "$PROJECT" -s "$PROFILE"; WGT="$(find "$BUILD" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.wgt' -print -quit)"; [ -n "$WGT" ] || { echo 'ERROR: WGT not found'; exit 1; }; LIST="$(unzip -l "$WGT")"; case "$LIST" in *signature1.xml*) ;; *) echo "ERROR: $WGT is not signed - check PROFILE=$PROFILE"; exit 1;; esac; case "$LIST" in *js/app.js*) ;; *) echo 'ERROR: js/app.js missing from package - check the files: list in tizen_web_project.yaml'; exit 1;; esac; echo "WGT: $WGT"; echo '=== Install ==='; "$TIZEN" install -s "$TV" -n "$(basename "$WGT")" -- "$(dirname "$WGT")"; echo '=== DONE ==='
